# Elm Court residents' minutes

This folder holds the minutes of the Elm Court residents' association, one file per monthly meeting under `minutes/`, and the list of open actions in `actions.md`. The nine committee members all work in this folder.

## How the folder is shared

The folder is shared live. It syncs to every member's computer as soon as a file is saved, and there is no version history and no commit step. It is not under version control. It commits or holds no skills: each member keeps their own tools on their own computer.

## Rules

- Write the decisions first in the minutes, then the actions.
- Give every action one owner and a date, such as "by 14 November".
- Refer to a member by first name and flat number, such as "Noor (flat 12)".
- Never put a resident's phone number in the minutes.
